items.text: Hello detectives,
We have released a demo update and patch for the full game today.
The demo update brings this in line with the full released version of the game.
Patch 1.1.12.360 includes a number of improvements and fixes to the full game.
The full changelog can be found below (please note this changelog may contain spoilers).
Various bug fixes and stability improvements, bringing the demo in line with the full game.
UI and settings changes
Added the option to turn V-Sync off via the Options menu
Added target frame rate option
Changed binding for cycling through hotspot interactions to Q
Implemented a double click to skip option for dialogue
Added an option to disable skipping dialogue.
Order of categories in the Records and Discussable screens now align more closely with each other
Guest names are now sorted by last name
UI and settings bug fixes
Fixed a visual error on the how to play screen background
Increased scroll sensitivity on how to play screen
Fixed an issue where the hourglass tutorial window didn’t work with the Tutorial Mode set to Press
Preventing time data being carried over when loading save from main menu
Credits updated
Fixed an issue where the journal could get stuck on specific mindmaps after tutorials forcibly bring you to a specific one
Fixed an issue where inputs start working during ftue if alt tabbing out and back in
Changed where the cursor disabling/enabling happens during loading
Fixed an issue where the game continues to react to your mouse clicks when using Steam overlay.
Made ampm work on timetable screen for cultures with different characters
Stopped multiple hypothesis considerations from triggering when button is spammed
Fixed some issues with the journal’s behaviour on closing and switching tabs
Corrected position of the monument on the maze map
Fixed an issue that enabled players to accidentally press F5 to Quick Save while in the Title Screen
Items should only show up as discussable with Varley after you have met him.
Audio
Removed rogue fire sfx
Fixed an issue where Ettienne’s voice audio would stop before the line was finished
Added missing door sounds to some scene transitions
Adjusted sfx for analysis
Ensured voice over lines respect volume settings.
Wind and crows SFX will fade out when you enter the ballroom from the walled garden, when
Doyle kicks you out of the walled garden for the seance and when you enter the church.
Thunder and rain sfx should now play during the seance.
Fixed an issue where music did not play in gardens during day 3 before the seance
Fixed some music issues after loading a save at the seance.
Fixed wind and rain for some Day 3 cutscenes
Journal
Various adjustments to NPC mind maps
Various adjustments to Main Mystery mind maps
Updated religious lore for characters.
Environment
Sigil fire effects should no longer disappear when you leave the room.
Stopped Sigil lines from disappearing when moving the camera away from them.
Added missing top face collider to an object in Manager’s Office.
Fixed some incorrect shadows and floating characters
Alcohol bottle now has more generic logo
Fixed various occlusion culling issues
Visually corrected some light sources in the Manor.
Corrected the Library name plaque
Fixed an issue where containers would not auto-close after walking away from them
Removed an old door hotspot for the ballroom door
Fix to prevent the player from getting stuck on a crate cart puzzle
Drawing room rope will now not still be there after time skip.
Updated age of Percival Blake’s death.
Fixed a visual issue with Atrium door windows in the Ballroom from 5PM onwards on day 3
The typewriter should correctly reset on day 2.
Door open position and hotspots are now remembered in the storeroom.
Renamed travel plans hotspot to map of Europe.
Fixed highlight on garden gate
Footstep sounds on tiles outside bedroom should now play correctly.
Removed the hotspot from Lau’s nightstand
Time
Each of Hazel's lockbox barks should only take a single click now.
All coats in the cloakroom now cost 1 tick
Fixed an issue where you could progress time infinitely by interacting with one object in Ines room
Removed time cost from an item in Skerrit’s room, and fixed collider
Lore
Added Doyle writing fact to pile of books
Added shoe size onto Jonathan Blake's shoe bark.
Removed fact and all references to fact for O Finn - He cannot read or write English.
Caitlin fact - I found some of her writings - Unlocks if you have discarded note and bible.
Caitlin fact - Writing lore wording tweaked, and unlocked on women's dorm letter.
Carmela fact - Writing lore wording tweaked, and unlocked on crumpled note in laundry.
Fixed bug where you can't access Blake’s shoes in the empty bedroom.
Sinnott fact - In his mid-60s - should drop when you speak to him normally.
Jonathan Blake fact - He is mourning his late wife - unlocks when you present Mary Blake.
Saoirse fact - Miss Deane had started to teach her magic - unlocks on ballroom eavesdrop.
Hunter fact - He is in his mid-50s - drops when you speak to him for the first time in the front courtyard on day 2, 12PM.
Doyle fact - He is in his late 20s - Unlocks if you speak to him before a meal in the east corridors.
Ines fact - She is mourning the recent loss of her mother - Unlocks when you look at burial record.
Cathal fact - I found writings in his journal in his room - Unlocks when you interact with his journal.
Carmela fact - she is a famed mystic, who is helming the séance. Unlocks whenever you get conductor of the seance.
Seamus fact - age lore should unlock when you click on the dining room door.
Misc
Addressed various typos
Fixed missing lip animations for a cutscene with Etienne
Ensured sigils still work when reloading a scene from a save.
Fixed an issue where only right clicking through a cutscene will prevent the cursor from showing to scroll through the dialog.
Fixed an issue with the Brandy staying disappeared when reloading a save.
Disabled inaccurate barks when you've found everything in rooms.
Protestant service should fire a notification when you eavesdrop.
Fixed an issue with the crow appearing outside without triggering the cutscene
Fixed an issue causing Ward to die too when loading a save in the church at the end of the game.
Changed conditions for the final bit of dialogue unlocking for the sigil under O Finn's bed to avoid early spoilers.
Angry face comic panel now appears in church cutscene
Fixed an issue where loading a save incorrectly reenables the spirit board minigame
Corrected low res evidence art for Rejected Request and Letter from Doctor Callaghan
Added a hotspot for Mantovani’s remains after the seance ritual cutscene
Fixed flickering image issues on the Point of No Return screen
Fixed issues where O Finn’s kidnapping could be spoiled for players by some text/dialogue if they hadn’t found out yet
Moved Ettienne to the bar at 5PM and updated his timetable dialogue accordingly.
Made Ward's reaction in the church after the Seance play by default instead of via an awkwardly placed hotspot
Fixed an issue where players were able to manually save at moments saving is meant to be blocked
The Séance of Blake Manor is OUT NOW.
Hello detectives,
We have released Patch 1.0.801.75 today.
This update addresses issues reported by the community.
Please be aware that the following changelog may contain spoilers.
Fixed an issue making the wine cellar lock invisible for some players
Removed old game logic causing an issue with a “Longing” node from the Haunting Mind Map
The game will no longer freeze when completing O Finn’s Hypothesis in the washroom
Fixed a memory leak by stopping unnecessary texture instantiation on panoply panel texture updates
Thank you for bringing these issues to our attention and for your patience while the team worked to get these issues resolved.
The Séance of Blake Manor is OUT NOW.
Hello detectives,
We have just released Patch 1.0.796.64 to address a number of issues reported by the community.
Please note that the following changelog may contain spoilers:
Changelog
Updated a number of mindmap act node priorities
Adjusted hotspot for carpet in room 7 and doors in stable
Added missing dialogue for presenting cigar burns to some characters
Adjusted some Mind Map connections so they now correctly turn green
Deleting a save via the pause menu will no longer make the time/day UI disappear
Interacting with the Percival Portrait will no longer spoil Deane's Bedroom Mystery
Removed Campbell from church map at 12 day 3
Fixed a typo on the Entertainment Schedule
Addressed some miscellaneous lore issues
Adjusted NPC class info UI
Set FOV to default on certain cutscenes
You are no longer blocked from talking to Varley/Doyle once a meal is over until the next hour
Fixed some door transition sound effects
No longer possible to spoil the Hedge Maze scene before starting the masked ball by ending Day 2 in the hedge maze
Ruairi no longer stays in his room if you trigger the 9PM hour change on Day 2 while in his room with him after he has taken your picture
Ward no longer knows how to lucid dream without learning how.
Hedge Maze evidences is given on completing the Blake residence hypothesis
Gates in Blake Residence are open or closed correctly after loading a save
]Information (blueprints) about the Strange Device from the atrium can now be found in the Blake Residence
Action bar now appears on HUD post Séance
Fixed some issues during the D'Arcy and Varley eavesdrop about her key
Quinn mindmap: Learn about family history node should now dim and show on "current focus”
Quinn mystery no longer shows the green "I helped to lift the curse from the Quinn family." connection after confronting her and before doing nothing else
Painting added to Cathal’s room
Now possible to get all of Varley's Evidence
Hazel confront lead should close at the correct time
Updated dialogue and description of wanted poster
Added a new outcome for Mantovani if Ward solves every NPC mystery
Observation text of family photographs now matches updated location of evidences.
Improvements made to Mantovani mind map, including animation and updated connection descriptions.
Some improvements for Ivy, Victoria, and Darragh’s mindmaps
Some improvements for Doyle’s mindmap
Added additional barks to clipboard in the basement
Fixed an issue where teleporting from Varley's office resulted in not being able to enter the Lobby afterwards while Varley is there
Fixed an issue where Ward could sometimes not enter Atrium door on Day 1
Thank you for your continued support of The Séance of Blake Manor and for letting us know about these issues so that they could be investigated by the team.
The Séance of Blake Manor is OUT NOW.
